title: Concept: Module path cannot be resolved by any proxy
description: go.mod declares a module path with no domain component, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a module path with no domain component.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a module path with no domain component.
